title: Base Ecosystem Fund
description: The strategic investment arm of Base. In partnership with Coinbase Ventures, it invests in pre-seed and seed stage startups that choose Base as their home, with hands-on ecosystem support, partner credits and priority access to Coinbase products. Applications are open with no stated deadline.
reward: Pre-seed and seed investment from the Base Ecosystem Fund, in partnership with Coinbase Ventures (amount not stated)

eligibility.note: a pre-seed or seed stage startup that chooses Base as its home

each_time: founder details, traction and fundraising goals
rules: Rolling: the application is open on base.org with no stated deadline.
For pre-seed and seed stage startups that choose Base as their home. Base invests in partnership with Coinbase Ventures.
Base says it invests in top talent building enduring, high-performance onchain primitives and businesses that drive real economic activity.

Portfolio support: hands-on help from the ecosystem team with partner integrations and distribution; credits from partners including AWS, Azure, Alchemy and Spindl ad credits; priority access to Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Business and the Coinbase Onramp API.
The application has five steps (Company, Team, Idea, Funding, Why Base) and takes one to four founders. The pitch deck link is the only optional field.
